method: Unchanged ContainerRepair (zu), its output slot (zw), input inventory (zv), ItemStack, EnchantmentHelper, the enchantment registry, ItemEnchantedBook and the NBT classes, run in a JVM after Block/Item registration. The container is built with its real constructor. Doubles: a constructor-less EntityPlayer carrying capabilities, experience fields and a seeded Entity.rand, and a World exposing one anvil cell (getBlock, getBlockMetadata, setBlockMetadataWithNotify, setBlockToAir, playAuxSFX logged). Each repair row: put left, put right, send the name (when set), read the output slot, maximumCost and stackSizeToBeUsedInRepair, then SlotRepairOutput.canTakeStack at a recorded experience level and, for a subset, onPickupFromSlot. Row layout: [left, right, name, creative, remote, anvilMeta, seed, level, experienceTotal, output, maximumCost, stackSizeToBeUsedInRepair, canTake, take] with stacks [id, count, damage, ench, stored, unbreakable, RepairCost, customName] and take [input1, level, total, progress, worldEvents, anvilMeta, maximumCost, input0, nextInt]. Localisation: the JAR carries no en_US.lang, so ItemStack.getDisplayName of an unnamed stack is its unlocalised key (names table); the replay supplies the same table. Not covered: GUI, packets (MC|ItemName filtering), shift-click merging (transferStackInSlot), rendering and sounds beyond the playAuxSFX ids.
